title: Cardholder Uplift on Out-of-Area Tow Reimbursements
content:
Crestline Credit Card holders receive an uplift on the allowance for an out-of-area tow under Road Hazard Protection.

**Tow card uplift.** A holder who has a Crestline Credit Card account in status active and no late fee posted on their Crestline card accounts in the last 12 whole calendar months adds 10 USD to the tow allowance; a holder with an active Crestline card account and one or more such late fees in that period adds 5 USD; any other holder adds nothing.

| Active Crestline Credit Card account | Late fees, last 12 whole months | Added to the tow allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | 10.00 |
| yes | one or more | 5.00 |
| no | (not relevant) | nothing |
